page.title: Self-improvement
page.intro: Guaardvark runs its own tests, drafts fixes and stages them for your review. Nothing reaches the code until you approve and apply it, and Codebase locked stops every change.

codeKeeps.approved: Code keep approved. Apply it from Pending fixes.
codeKeeps.title: Code keeps
codeKeeps.intro: Swarm arms that passed preserve-and-extend. Approve here, then apply from Settings — nothing auto-merges to main.

controls.title: Self-improvement
controls.help: Guaardvark checks its own code and proposes fixes for you to review. Codebase locked blocks every automatic edit.
controls.enabledTooltip: Lets the mentor scan the codebase and propose fixes for review.
controls.lockedOnTooltip: Autonomous edits are blocked. Turn off to allow them.
controls.lockedOffTooltip: Turn on to block every autonomous edit to the source tree.
controls.runTooltip: Runs the checks now. Cancel asks the server to stop; closing the view leaves the scan running.
controls.lockedNote: Codebase is locked: autonomous edits are blocked.
controls.pendingFixesHelp: Fixes the self-check proposed, waiting for you to review or apply. Nothing reaches the code until you approve and apply it.

selfEdits.title: Changes Guaardvark made to itself
selfEdits.none: Guaardvark has not changed its own code yet. Ask it to, in plan mode, and approve the plan.
